0x0008BA.en: 「At my level...@　this is as far as I go...!」

0x0009B3.en: 「Damn it!@　I won't lose next time!」

0x000A2D.en: 「Is this... as far as I go...?」

0x000BDD.en: 「Ngh! So this is as far as it goes...!」

0x000C18.en: 「Screwing up in a place like this...!@　This isn't fun...」

0x000C6C.en: 「I blew it...!@　No choice but to bail...」

0x000D56.en: 「This is as far as I go...!」

0x000DBD.en: 「This is the end... I leave the rest to you.」

0x000DEF.en: 「Damn it...!@　So this is the end!」

0x000E2B.en: 「Nngh! So they got the drop on me...」

0x000E69.en: 「No good, we've taken too much damage... Retreating!」

0x000EB6.en: 「Well, that's a shame. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x000EF4.en: 「Kyah, I leave the rest to you!」

0x000F3B.en: 「To think the Granzon... would be shot down...」

0x000FE6.en: 「Ngh... To think I'd be the shooting star... Ejecting!」

0x00109D.en: 「Owowow... I give. My math was off.」

0x001122.en: 「Nnrgh! So this is as far as I go...!」

0x00118F.en: 「Ngh! All hands, abandon ship at once!!」

0x0011D6.en: 「I'm sorry. I'll leave the rest to you.」

0x00120B.en: 「Damn it! Is this the limit of my power...!」

0x0012F7.en: 「Beaten in a place like this...@ I'm still not ready...!」

0x001345.en: 「No good, I can't go on! Retreating!」

0x001400.en: 「Sorry, I'm leaving the rest to you!」

0x00146D.en: 「Well, well. So this is where it ends.」

0x00149C.en: 「I can't go any further. I'll take my leave.」

0x001527.en: 「Careless of me...@ I'll pull back for now...!」

0x00174B.en: 「Guhhh! Not in a place like this!!」

0x0019E6.en: 「I see... A fine finish indeed.@ And the divine servants haven't appeared yet, have they?」

0x001A4F.en: 「Yes. Proof, I believe, that their power has grown.」

0x001A8F.en: 「Our god, too, thanks to the Ruina,@ seems about to awaken at last.@ Taihoku, I'd say the time is near. What do you think?」

0x001B51.en: 「Thanks, as always, for the answer I hoped for.@ Now, grace and protection to the poor commonfolk...@ So, I'll trouble you now.」

0x001C2B.en: 「Kanan, don't bring back the wrong one.@ I know you're taken with the Seiryu girl, but@ there is such a thing as priority.」

0x001CDF.en: 「Hmph... I'll leave the welcome to Hou.」

0x001D13.en: 「Indeed. Meanwhile, Kanan and I will draw their attention.@ ...Hou, see that you make no mistakes.」

0x001D8E.en: 「Kouryu, don't neglect the preparations to receive them.」

0x001DC2.en: 「Of course.@ I want a flashy debut this time,@ so I'll get ready to set out as well.」

0x001E67.en: 「Those two units are, if anything, close to the Masou Kishin.」

0x001EC9.en: 「They share a concept similar to our humanoid mobile weapons,@ but they run on a system all their own.」

0x001F52.en: 「I'd predicted as much, from analyzing the Ruina@ machines we've shot down so far, but...」

0x001FCC.en: 「There's no guarantee the other Melior Esse Ess units are the same.@ Some, like Contagio's machine,@ seem to be a kind of bioweapon.」

0x002098.en: 「Yeah...@ That one's closer to an <Einst>, if anything.」

0x0020ED.en: 「The story that Glacies is a Melior Esse Ess made@ by extracting human knowledge and imagery...@ If that's true...」

0x00218F.en: 「Then it's no surprise the Fabularis and Studium@ are built like our humanoid mobile weapons.」

0x00221E.en: 「...Whose knowledge and imagery was it based on?」

0x00227A.en: (But then, who was there that day...)

0x0022B4.en: 「Also, not every material used in those two units@ is something unknown to us.」

0x002325.en: 「And there are parts that resemble the Aile Chevalier@ and the Blanche Neige.」

0x0023BB.en: 「Just as I expected, they were fitted with devices@ like the Race Arcana and the Sympathia.」

0x002441.en: 「The latter, however, is damaged,@ so I can't make out the details for now, but...@ can you two fight in that condition?」

0x0024EA.en: 「The power drops, but...@ we can still control the units.」

0x002540.en: 「It's precisely because that system is damaged@ that we escape the rule of the 'King of Ruin.'」

0x0025BA.en: 「I can tell it's that sort of device, but...@ why did it have a function that lets it sync with a human mind?」

0x00264C.en: 「Because I was given the role@ of understanding human emotions...」

0x0026A8.en: 「I merely used what I was given.」

0x0026EB.en: (Even a Melior Esse Ess isn't told@ what truly matters, it seems...)

0x002750.en: 「Ventos, this talk about your role@ and mine being alike...@ what on earth did you mean by that?」

0x0027E0.en: 「By touching the Sympathia, you came@ to hold two souls...@ That's what I felt at our first sync.」

0x002888.en: 「And... I thought it was so you could understand@ the human heart in all its complexity...」

0x0028F9.en: 「I'm... no, we're human, aren't we?@ Why would I have a role like that... and who's@ supposed to have given it to me?」

0x002992.en: 「I don't know...@ Thinking back now, maybe it's because@ I saw myself inside you...」

0x002A13.en: 「You thought so because you saw yourself...?@ So you didn't have any real basis for saying that, did you?」

0x002A9F.en: 「No, I only spoke what I felt...@ And if that's thrown you into confusion,@ then I'm sorry...」

0x002B45.en: 「...Cliff, the Sympathia and Race Arcana@ we use... they're the Ruina's...」

0x002BC8.en: 「They're similar, but not the exact same thing.@ Still, it's possible whoever made them@ used the Ruina's as a reference.」

0x002C58.en: 「The ones who made the Fabula Fores, then...@ Do you have any idea who, Glacies?」

0x002CD2.en: 「No... Not even Umbra and the others told us.」

0x002D18.en: 「Besides...@ we've never set foot in the deepest part@ of the place you call the Fabula Fores.」

0x002DB7.en: 「Then... you've never seen my father and the others in the ruins...?」

0x002E1F.en: 「So to learn the truth, we've no choice@ but to go to the Fabula Fores.」

0x002E87.en: 「But it won't be something we can do right away.」

0x002ECA.en: 「I know. We can't beat the Ruina on our own.@ As long as we act with the Steel Dragons,@ we have to fight the others too.」

0x002F78.en: 「...What a bother. Cease to exist, and you'd be free of it.」

0x002FC7.en: 「Humans fear death. Nobody wants to die.@ Someday, you'll understand that too.」

0x00303E.en: 「My life is nothing but a fabrication.」

0x003075.en: 「Even so, there are those who live on in this unit.」

0x0030F8.en: 「A shortened name. Then call me Raki.」

0x003222.en: (Odds of engaging the enemy...@ Ruina... Guests... Baral...)

0x003278.en: (And the Gaia Sabers...@ We may run into other Sabers, but Duvan...)

0x0032EC.en: (Where is he, and doing what...?@ Ugh...!)

0x00335E.en: (Sooner than I expected...@ These symptoms... already at Stage 2...?)

0x0033C3.en: (Restricting part of the somatic nervous system...@ regulating heart rate... forced dormancy............)

0x003457.en: 「Yeah... it felt like the last one, but...」

0x003494.en: 「I don't remember what we talked about, but...@ I felt like I had to go home...」

0x003534.en: (Could it be... Irui's memories are coming back...?)

0x003580.en: 「Seolla, shouldn't we tell Ibis@ and Second Lieutenant Kusuha and the others@ about this too?」

0x0035FE.en: 「But Ibis and the others are out on patrol right now.」

0x00367E.en: 「Irui, don't worry.@ Whatever happens, we'll protect you.」

0x003733.en: 「The moment Ibis and the others return, we head out.@ No change to the route, formation A5.」

0x0037B6.en: 「Roger. All right, Ariel...@ let's get out there on patrol.」

0x003831.en: 「Hm? You look a little pale... you okay?」

0x00388A.en: （The forced sleep restored me, but@　I can't let Excellen and the others worry.@　I have to change the subject......）

0x003951.en: 「Yes.@　But more than that... am I intruding?」

0x0039C6.en: 「This team... I thought maybe@　you'd be better off without me.」

0x003A22.en: 「Oh, come on. You don't need to worry about that.@ Ariel, your Flickerei is Alt's little sister unit.@ It's not like you're a stranger.」

0x003B16.en: 「Still, it's a surprise to hear@　you say something like that, Ariel.」

0x003B94.en: 「Nope. If anything, it's nice.@　Maybe it's the people around you rubbing off?」

0x003C1E.en: （No, neither I... nor he... will change.@　......We won't change.）

0x003C74.en: 「Oh, I know!@　Once this whole mess is over, why not join the ATX Team?@　We'd love to have you.」

0x003D2C.en: 「Major Gilliam and Major Kai can@　smooth that part over somehow......@　what do you think, Kyosuke?」

0x003DC5.en: 「If Ariel's fine with it, I've no objection.」

0x003EBE.en: 「Well, it was pretty sudden.@　Take your time thinking it over......」

0x004026.en: 「Ariel, summon Axel.@　And tell the bridge the situation.@　Say we're heading out ahead.」

0x00417F.en: 「Just as I planned. Mark the Steel Dragon Squadron@　and the odds of meeting you go up......@　I won't let you escape, Einst Alfimi.」

0x00423C.en: 「I told you before... even if you take my power......」

0x0042A1.en: 「See for yourself. The Faust Kern is active......@　more than last time.」

0x004303.en: 「That can't be... it's impossible......@ The Persoenlichkeit's power......」

0x0043D1.en: 「Heh, heheh... too late, Ariel.@　I've taken it. The core of the <Einst>......!」

0x004523.en: 「Kh, ugh......!@　Quite a power. It's all I can do just to hold it down.」

0x00457F.en: 「No way...!@ A fake core, absorbing the real one!」

0x0045CF.en: 「But with this power, I may change my cursed destiny......@　the very shape of my life.」

0x00464F.en: 「The shape of your life...?@　Duvan, you......!」

0x004696.en: 「So you already knew, then -@　about the lifespan the Idealants were assigned.」

0x004782.en: 「You knew, and you laughed at me. At the fool@　who never saw the truth, who became a pawn@　of the Gaia Sabers.」

0x004849.en: 「No matter. I've already set things in motion.@　To overturn my cursed destiny and elevate@　Project Idealants with my own hands......」

0x004953.en: 「This is your final notice, Ariel.@　Come to me. With this power of Ares,@　we can become beings beyond the Idealants.」

0x004A16.en: 「At the cost of Alfimi, you mean.」

0x004A4D.en: 「What of it?@　She's a scion of the Einst who once@　sought to erase this world.」

0x004AC5.en: 「That's ancient history.@　The Alfimi of now is different.」

0x004B5C.en: 「Looks like you can't hold it in... Alfimi's power.」

0x004B9C.en: 「But you too kept yourself alive@　with this same power, didn't you...!」

0x004BEF.en: 「So Alfimi claimed, but perhaps@　I was simply blessed with dumb luck.」

0x004C60.en: 「Hmph, the data speaks... that girl has@　the power to revive the dying.@　You're proof enough of that.」

0x004CFF.en: 「And if I, not a mere human but@　an Idealant, make it my own......」

0x004D76.en: 「Duvan, we have no power to suppress the Einst,@　nor to control people......」

0x004DE7.en: 「Do you think one who's only bound to perish@　can stand above those who go on living?」

0x004E68.en: 「And after that, what will you do......?」

0x004EA5.en: 「Build a new order.@　Those who rule and those ruled by absolute power......@　humans need play no part in it.」

0x004F4D.en: 「Then what is it you mean to rule?」

0x004F81.en: 「The flow of energy that exists in this world.@　That is the dominion Project Idealants@　defines......」

0x00501D.en: 「The Einst and Ruina from another world......@　I'll control the energy they bring as well,@　and build a new order.」

0x0050BC.en: 「Yes, not humans......@　I will become the one who governs this world itself.」

0x00512D.en: 「Aiming high, aren't you.@　The Machinery Children said much@　the same thing before, didn't they?」

0x0051B7.en: 「Those creatures, the <Machine Cells>... none of them@　come close to me, master of the <Einst> power.@　And Ariel... if you join me too......」

0x005266.en: 「......Duvan, history itself proves it.@　The DC, the Machine Cells, the ODE System... every@　order they tried to build was rejected.」

0x005366.en: 「Because they meddled with events beyond measure,@　and were swallowed by the torrent they unleashed.」

0x0053CE.en: 「No, there's a simpler, and more fatal, cause.」

0x00542A.en: 「They... no, we ourselves once@　failed to destroy the enemy we should have, when we should have.」

0x0054A4.en: 「Yes, this world holds a troublesome@　deterrent force... this one right here.」

0x005506.en: 「I see......@　So this is what I'm looking at now.@　That's why you're here, Ariel.」

0x0055DF.en: 「Very well. You live among humans.@ I live for my duty as a species...@ Let's see whose breed truly rules, before your comrades!」

0x0056AE.en: 「Hmph, don't underestimate an Ares@　that's gained the Einst's power!」

0x0056FE.en: 「Even you, who once faced the Einst,@　cannot defeat me.」

0x00576C.en: 「Only if you're the real thing.@　I won't lose to an imitation......!」

0x0057BC.en: 「The Einst power you couldn't fully master......@　I'll show you how it's wielded!」

0x005842.en: 「I'll warn you, from experience, this won't come cheap.@　You might not make it back, you know.」

0x0058BC.en: 「I made my peace with that long ago......@　I'll surpass humanity, and the Idealants!」

0x005964.en: 「This world rejected not only the Shadow Mirror@　but the Einst as well.@　It's not something you can command.」

0x0059F4.en: 「If I can pinpoint where events converge, it's possible!@　I'm the new species granted that ability,@　an Idealant!」

0x005A87.en: 「Hmph, big talk. Is that another Idealant trait?」

0x005ACA.en: 「......What's wrong? Weren't you going to stop me?」

0x005B16.en: 「Duvan's actually starting to control@　Alfimi's power......!?」

0x005B97.en: 「This is getting a little past the point of a joke.」

0x005BD7.en: 「Hmph, and you call that a deterrent......」

0x005C21.en: 「Hmm... there's one here with an unusual soul-color.@　It stirs my interest.」

0x005C80.en: 「Ah, seems he took a fragment of the Hundred Evils@　into himself of his own will.」

0x005CEC.en: 「In any case, let's wait for the players to gather.@　They're nearly all here now.」

0x005D7C.en: （Chris......@　Even riding this one, I still can't hear his voice......@　The hole in my heart is still there......）

0x005E75.en: 「Don't worry, big brother.@　He'll come back for sure... I believe that,@　so for now, I'll do what needs doing.」

0x005F12.en: 「Are those two really gonna be all right?」

0x005F71.en: 「Yes. I was made to fight......@　and I was fated to fade away.@　I have no fear of ceasing to exist.」

0x00600D.en: 「That's not it. You have to survive......@　no, you have to have the will to live.」

0x00607B.en: 「......If you say so, then I'll try.」

0x0060F9.en: 「If Glacies is Raki, then you're Wen.@　That's what I'm going to call you.」

0x00617A.en: 「Wen... if you're gone,@　Chris's feelings will have been for nothing.@　So you're going to live.」

0x006210.en: 「Yes... I'll stake my life for your sake.@　So that one day I'll understand what it means......」

0x006284.en: 「Staking your life is fine, but don't throw it away.」

0x0062EC.en: 「Ho, those two......@ they've added the Ruina's Hollow Men to their forces.」

0x006345.en: 「Taking in good and evil, pure and foul, as their own power......@　perhaps that's why the shrine maiden marked them.」

0x0063CE.en: 「Mm, it's much like our own aim.」

0x00640B.en: 「Sorry, but we don't have time@　to bother with you old hermits.」

0x00645E.en: 「Kanan, Taihoku... no matter how many times you appear,@　I've no mind to shed this shell or to bow to Baral.」

0x0064D2.en: 「Don't take it so hard. Today, just spar with@ the Spirit-Machines for a little while.」

0x006581.en: 「I can't believe you came at us for that alone.@　What's your true aim?」

0x0065DA.en: 「Move them with gain, wait for them with deceit......@　there was a sage who said such things.」

0x006660.en: 「The one who fights well brings others to him,@　and is not brought by them... don't think that works on us.」

0x00670B.en: （Set them against each other, and the flow tilts my way.@　I'll pinpoint the convergence of this event.）

0x006785.en: 「Quite the interruption, but I won't let you flee, Duvan.@　I've still got a score to settle for Alfimi.」

0x00680E.en: 「Heh, there's no need to settle it anymore.」

0x006842.en: 「......Kyosuke, Excellen, Ariel.@　He's holding together on a dangerous balance,@　nothing more. A backlash is bound to come.」

0x006912.en: 「What about the chance he goes berserk?」

0x006952.en: 「I can't rule it out. We have to hurry!」

0x006983.en: 「Heh, hehehe... the core's settling in.@　My Ares can't be stopped now!」

0x006A09.en: 「It won't last long. Even more so for a fake core.」

0x006A68.en: 「With this power, I can stand against not just the@　Steel Dragon Squadron, but Baral and Ruina too!」

0x006B16.en: 「Mm, by now Hou should be moving things along.@ Let's await good news.」

0x006B9E.en: （My shrine maiden, Irui......@　At the far south, a baleful god that brings@　calamity from the stars is about to wake......）

0x006C25.en: (We're the guardians of paradise.@ We must shield our children there,@ from calamity born of sky, earth, and sea......)

0x006D07.en: （Awaken, Irui... unleash that fervent will......@　to protect paradise... to protect those you love......）

0x006D8D.en: （Come to the promised land, the garden of Baral......@　my shrine maiden, Irui... come to Baral......）

0x006E42.en: 「My deeds none may see, hear,@　nor remember......」

0x006EAA.en: 「We've come to fetch you, Lady Irui.@　Now, to the side of our god of Baral......」

0x006F12.en: 「I can see it, the convergence of this event.@　Axel, the removal of the deterrent that you@　once failed to achieve... I will......」

0x006FD6.en: 「What, the Faust Kern!?@　Why is the output dropping!?」

0x00702C.en: 「As if a fake could hold it in!@　Be grateful it didn't go berserk on you!」

0x007117.en: 「Don't tell me, that attack just now was......!?」

0x007151.en: 「Heh, fortune's still on my side......!@　I'll leave this bout for later, Ariel!」

0x0071FB.en: 「D-direct hit on the aft Tesla Drive pile!!」

0x007260.en: 「Those guys...@　they never came after us before now...!」

0x0072BF.en: 「Which means our wish has been granted.」

0x0073A5.en: 「You'll know soon enough. Like it or not.」

0x0073EC.en: 「Seems it went well. The divine servants have come for us.」

0x00743F.en: 「I'll take the shrine maiden and return by the Shrinking Method.」

0x007587.en: 「...Couldn't seize the moment@　when we were just one step away.」

0x0075FF.en: 「I'm sorry, this is all because I fell short...」

0x007670.en: 「But the whole thing started@　because Project Idealants...」

0x0076CF.en: 「No use bringing that up now, of all things.」

0x007709.en: 「Besides, it isn't settled that Alfimi@　was completely destroyed.」

0x00776B.en: 「Yes, it seems her power wasn't fully@　contained... and there's Ensign Hugo Medio's@　case to consider as well.」

0x007819.en: 「...Sooner or later, our path and Duvan's@　will cross again. All the more so if he@　means to remove the deterrent force.」

0x0078B5.en: 「How we deal with it next... that's what matters.」

0x00790E.en: 「Ariel... to predict Duvan's next move,@　tell us the truth about the Idealants.」

0x007997.en: 「...Understood. I stayed silent until now@　because I didn't want to worry you all...@　but I'll tell you.」

0x007A3C.en: 「The Idealants are an ideal race meant to@　eliminate human uncertainty as far as@　possible, achieving perfect rule and crisis control...」

0x007AD2.en: 「But Duvan and I, the test subjects,@　have a grave flaw.」

0x007B3A.en: 「He mentioned a limited lifespan... is that it?」

0x007B80.en: 「Yes.@　Our bodies reach their limit in about three years.」

0x007BE6.en: 「Yes... a problem arose when our bodies were@　made, setting a special in-vitro Hayflick limit.」

0x007CB5.en: 「After a set time, the body starts to break down.@ We only qualified as test subjects because three years@ was thought to be a relatively long viable span.」

0x007D8A.en: 「A three-year life... you call that long...?」

0x007DBB.en: 「With Dr. Enji Ozunu, our creator,@　now dead, there's no prospect of extending our lives...」

0x007E44.en: 「Learning the truth, Duvan means to@　prolong his life by absorbing Alfimi,@　surpass the Idealants' limit...」

0x007EE6.en: 「and eventually fully merge with Alles Geist...@ becoming something like Einst Regisseur, I suspect...」

0x007F94.en: 「And call it a new order... he means@　to become Einst's successor?」

0x007FF0.en: 「I... must stop Duvan by any means,@　with the time I have left.」

0x008086.en: 「By my calculations, just under two years...@　though it could be even shorter.」

0x0080EE.en: 「That can't be... isn't there any way?」

0x00815D.en: 「What!? And when did you get here!?」

0x0081C5.en: 「Well, it's not entirely unrelated to me.」

0x008218.en: 「It's not a hopeful solution, mind you.@　We put you into artificial hibernation and,@　in the meantime, find a way to extend your life.」

0x0082AB.en: 「Frankly, it just puts the problem off.@　But for now, it's the only way@　to stop your body from breaking down.」

0x00834D.en: 「I'm a different type of android from Ariel...@　but might the technology used in my body@　be of some use here?」

0x008429.en: 「Mm, we may need your help later on.」

0x008479.en: 「So the odds of extending her life aren't zero...?」

0x0084B3.en: 「To raise those numbers,@　it'd be best if she went to sleep right away.」

0x00851B.en: 「No...@　there's something I must do first.」

0x008571.en: 「Hey, Ariel...@　no trading away everything for it, okay?」

0x008607.en: 「Don't just think about now - think about the future too...@　about what happens after this fight is over.」

0x008672.en: 「And if you can't find your answer,@　remember what we talked about before the sortie. Okay?」

0x00870E.en: 「How you live is yours to decide.@　We can't give you time, but...」

0x008785.en: 「we can make a place for you.」

0x00881B.en: （Duvan... if you'd met these people@　in some other way...）

0x0088EC.en: 「Before the sortie she was with me and Arado...@　then she went back alone to Ibis and the others'@　room...」

0x00898E.en: 「When we returned to the ship,@　Irui was nowhere to be found...@　she always comes to greet us...」

0x008A18.en: 「She wouldn't have left the ship alone mid-battle.@　Search the ship again.」

0x008A80.en: 「O-of course, that's the plan, but...@　she'd said something that's been bugging me...」

0x008B0A.en: 「She had a dream... said she had to go home...」

0x008B91.en: 「But it's a fact she left her room mid-battle.@　Some crew member may have seen her@　aboard the ship afterward.」

0x008C30.en: 「Yes, so... could we put out a shipwide@　call for her? And check the ship's@　camera footage too...」

0x008CFD.en: 「Then we'll... go look for her@　one more time!」

0x008DA9.en: 「...From now on, that unknown will be@　designated 'Custos.' It's Latin for@　guardian.」

0x008EF4.en: 「Yeah... if that's Baral's guardian,@　it's a grave problem.」

0x008F53.en: 「...Then let me relay the Joint Chiefs' decision.@　Operation Reconquista will begin@　shortly, but...」

0x009121.en: 「Yes.@ This is so you can monitor the Ruina@ from above the South Pole...」

0x009196.en: 「and so you can respond swiftly should@　anything befall the Operation Reconquista@　combined fleet now assembling.」

0x009317.en: 「In Operation Icebreaker, Federation forces@ will feint on the ground while you break@ through the Ruina's barrier from above.」

0x0093DA.en: 「Understood, but... the Hagane's Tesla Drive@　was damaged in that last battle. Repairs will take time.」

0x00960B.en: 「What do you want with me, deserter@ from the Gaia Sabers? Depending on what@ this is, I'll report you to my superiors.」

0x0096A1.en: 「So you're interested in what I have to say.」

0x0096E4.en: 「A little, yes. What a man with no future@　intends to do all on his own...」

0x00975B.en: 「Heh. I've obtained the Einst core...@　the future.」

0x0097C4.en: 「And on that note, I have something to tell you...」

0x0097F5.en: 「Now then... the preparations are set. The maiden returns to Baral's god, and the Total Transcendence Plan advances to its next stage.」
